text:
anika: Quick sync on the rollback/toast + timeline flow. QA reported users click the toast expecting an immediate "undo" but we only surface undo inside the timeline. Can we align expectations?
samir: I think toast should be a doorway, not the action. Toast: short status + anchor. Timeline: full metadata + undo + diff preview.
marta: Agreed. Proposal: toast copy 'Rolled back to v{n} — open history' with an inline chevron that focuses and scrolls to the timeline entry. No undo in toast.
lina: Figma: add an anchored state for the timeline row (outline + 6px left indicator). Include a 180ms scroll+fade. Create reduced-motion frame that jumps to the item.
kevin: From infra: we'll add a query param /#history=entry-{id} and an API field 'reconciled_percent' so the UI shows a tiny propagation pill (40% -> 100%). For 100% we hide the pill.
aria: Accessibility: SR should announce both actions. Toast aria-live=polite: 'Rolled back to version 12'. When timeline opens via the toast, the timeline panel heading should be focused and read: 'Timeline opened: version 12 by @samir, 3 minutes ago'. Avoid abrupt focus jumps for keyboard users; focus should move to panel only when user activates the link.
amika: small name correction: it's anika :)
(marta): noted :slightly_smiling_face:
samir: Copy variants: A) 'Rolled back to v12 — view history' B) 'Rollback complete: v12 serving (100%) — view history' C) 'Rolled back to v12 — view history (undo in history)'. I'm leaning to A for brevity.
kevin: Prefer A as well. We can surface percent inside the timeline entry where the reconciliation bar lives.
lina: Micro: chevron should be keyboard-focusable, aria-label 'Open history for rollback to v12'. Also add a tooltip that reads full time e.g., 'May 3, 2026 14:22 UTC' while visible label says '2 minutes ago'.
aria: Contrast: timeline selected state currently fails 4.5:1 for body text. Use token-bg-4 or bump text weight. I'll add exact token names to the accessibility checklist. Also ensure the chevron hit target is 44px min.
marta: UX question: some PMs want an 'undo fast' in toast (single click) for quick reverts. Product rationale: risk of accidental undos. What if we add a persistent banner in the timeline with an 'Undo' CTA that stays for 10 minutes? That satisfies both safety and discoverability.
samir: Banner in timeline + undo modal with diff preview sounds good. Banner text: 'Rollback to v12 completed. Undo available for 10 minutes.'
kevin: We'll need an endpoint to extend undo window; backend can support 10m default. I'll log infra ticket.
lina: I'll prototype the banner + timeline anchored state and add motion/reduced-motion variants. Also add a hovercard on timeline rows showing diff summary and who triggered it.
aria: SR: when banner appears, announce 'Rollback complete. Undo available for 10 minutes. Press Enter to open history.' Ensure the Undo button has aria-label 'Undo rollback to v12, restores previous traffic allocation'.
designbot: Checklist: toast copy set to variant A, deep-link fragment implemented, timeline anchor animation + reduced-motion, propagation pill with reconciled_percent, timeline selected contrast token updated, persistent undo banner in timeline, tooltip humanized time + full timestamp, chevron aria-label, undo modal diff preview.
marta: Thanks everyone. I'll create tickets and attach the Figma frames. Will drop link here when ready. :thumbsup:
